attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Medicine (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1: programs approved or offered by ACCME (incl. joint providership), AAFP, AMA, AOA, Michigan Osteopathic Association, Michigan State Medical Society; passing an ABMS/ABPS/NBPAS certification exam (50 h); MOC activities (max 30 h); clinical training (50 h/year). Category 2: teaching, presentations, publications and other listed activities
rules.audit_note: Applying for renewal certifies compliance; the department audits a sample of renewed licensees. Keep CE documentation 4 years (implicit bias proof 6 years). Waiver requests at least 30 days before the last board meeting before expiry.

topics.who: Pain and symptom management; at least 1 of the 3 hours must cover controlled substances prescribing
1 hour per year of the license cycle (R 338.7004); may count toward the 150 hours
All applicants and licensees: training in identifying victims of human trafficking (R 338.2413)
Holders of a Michigan controlled substance license: opioids and controlled substances awareness training (R 338.3135), incl. MAPS use

rules.notes: Medicine (MD) licenses renew every 3 years on the issue date (R 338.7002). Board page links CE Broker for tracking CE. Data taken from the Michigan Administrative Code (ARS).
rules.rule_quote: (2) An applicant for license renewal who has been licensed in the 3-year period immediately preceding the application for renewal shall accumulate a minimum of 150 hours of continuing education in activities approved under R 338.2443 during the 3 years immediately preceding the application for renewal.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1: programs approved or offered by the AOA or the Michigan Osteopathic Association and other category 1 activities listed in R 338.143(2); at most 90 credits from category 2 activities
rules.audit_note: Applying for renewal certifies compliance; the department audits a sample. Keep CE documentation 4 years (implicit bias proof 6 years).

topics.who: Pain and symptom management; at least 1 of the 3 hours must cover controlled substances prescribing
1 hour per year of the license cycle (R 338.7004); may count toward the 150 hours
All applicants and licensees: training in identifying victims of human trafficking (R 338.120)
Holders of a Michigan controlled substance license: opioids and controlled substances awareness training (R 338.3135)

rules.notes: DOs are licensed by the separate Michigan Board of Osteopathic Medicine and Surgery (LARA). Triennial renewal on the issue date (R 338.7002). Rules read in the Michigan Administrative Code (ARS).
rules.rule_quote: (2) An applicant for license renewal who has been licensed in the 3-year period immediately preceding the application for renewal shall accumulate a minimum of 150 hours of continuing education credit in activities approved under R 338.143 during the 3 years immediately preceding the application for renewal.
